title: Ipsos survey: Cancer and stress top Romanians’ health concerns
summary: Cancer is the leading health concern among Romanians, cited by 50% of respondents in an international Ipsos survey. Stress ranked second at 42%, followed by cardiovascular disease at 32%. Meanwhile, obesity was cited by 30% of Romanian respondents and diabetes by 23%. Concern about cancer, cardiovascular disease, obesity, and diabetes was higher in Romania than the average across the 32 countries covered by the study, according to the press release. “Although cancer remains the main source of concern, we see stress approaching it significantly, indicating the growing impact of emotional and lifestyle factors on perceptions of health,” said Irina Nicolaescu, client director at Ipsos Romania.

title: Romania wins two bronze medals at European table tennis championships
summary: Romanian table tennis players Eduard Ionescu and Bernadette Szocs won the bronze medal in the mixed doubles event at the 2026 European Individual Championships in Ljubljana, Slovenia, on Thursday, October 15.
